name: United Kingdom
prevalence_note: Report Fraud (https://www.reportfraud.police.uk/), Ofcom & FCA 2025-2026: HMRC unpaid-tax/bailiff & National Insurance compromise threats, bank Authorised Push Payment (APP) 'safe account' & card-courier fraud, BT/Sky/Virgin broadband cut-off remote-access calls, WhatsApp recruitment task scams, and cold-call crypto/share scams dominate.
cross_border_note: Overseas scam call centres heavily spoof +44 UK geographic (01/02) and mobile (07) numbers as well as official bank, HMRC, and Ofcom CLI numbers; although Ofcom mandates blocking unauthenticated international calls displaying UK numbers, VoIP gateways and SIM boxes still route cross-border vishing calls to UK residents.

scams.name: HMRC Unpaid Tax Arrest Warrant, Bailiffs & National Insurance Compromise
scams.name_en: HMRC unpaid tax arrest threat, bailiffs, or compromised National Insurance number scam
scams.signals_en: Caller or robocall posing as HMRC or the police claims there is an arrest warrant or bailiff enforcement over unpaid tax, or that the owner's National Insurance number was compromised, demanding immediate bank transfer, gift vouchers...
scams.legit_en: HMRC, the police, and genuine payroll or accounting contacts never threaten immediate arrest or same-day bailiffs by phone, never demand payment in gift vouchers or crypto, and handle tax codes or Self Assessment calmly via official letters and GOV.UK...
bait_tactics: Sound polite and scatterbrained, say your reading glasses are upstairs, and ask which P60 tax year is affected while pretending to rummage through a kitchen drawer of old letters
Ask them to explain slowly how the unpaid tax amount was worked out because you retired or changed employers

scams.name: UK Bank Fraud Team 'Safe Account' (APP Fraud) & Card Courier
scams.name_en: Fake UK bank fraud team asking to move funds to a safe account or hand card to courier
scams.signals_en: Claims inside bank branch staff are corrupt or the account is under attack; instructs the owner to move savings via Faster Payments to a newly opened 'safe account', read out a one-time passcode, or hand their bank card and PIN to a courier.
scams.legit_en: Genuine UK banks and building societies block compromised cards and post replacements without ever asking customers to transfer funds to a safe account, share one-time passcodes, or hand cards to a courier; fraud is reported to Report Fraud.
bait_tactics: Pretend your card reader battery just died and you are looking for spare batteries in the shed while asking how the safe account interest works
Slowly ask whether Faster Payments has a daily transfer cap and pretend the mobile banking app keeps logging out

scams.name: Indeed / Recruitment WhatsApp Task Scam
scams.name_en: Fake recruiter asking to add WhatsApp for remote task or review work
scams.signals_en: Robocall or fake recruiter claiming to represent Indeed or a UK recruitment agency instructs the owner to add a number on WhatsApp for easy daily pay rating apps or hotels, which soon requires cryptocurrency top-up deposits.
scams.legit_en: Genuine UK recruiters discuss a specific CV application and arrange formal interviews via corporate email or scheduled calls without asking candidates to add random WhatsApp numbers or deposit funds to unlock wages.
bait_tactics: Act keen on the extra income, pretend you cannot figure out where the add-contact button is on WhatsApp, and ask them to describe the daily tasks in detail
Ask whether the role includes a workplace pension and tax onboarding paperwork before opening any messaging app

scams.name: Fake Broadband Provider or Ofcom: Line Cut Off Today
scams.name_en: Fake BT Openreach, Sky, Virgin Media, or Ofcom caller threatening immediate broadband disconnection
scams.signals_en: Caller posing as BT Openreach, Sky Broadband, Virgin Media, or Ofcom claims the owner's IP address is compromised and broadband will be cut off today unless they install remote support software or confirm bank details for compensation.
scams.legit_en: UK broadband providers and Ofcom never make unsolicited calls threatening same-day line disconnection, never ask to install remote-access software, and never request banking details over an unexpected phone call.
bait_tactics: Say the broadband router is tucked behind a heavy bookcase in the hallway and ask what colour each indicator light should be showing
Ask what time the disconnection is scheduled and pretend your desktop computer is still installing system updates

scams.name: High-Return Share & Crypto Cold-Call Scam
scams.name_en: Unsolicited high-return investment and cryptocurrency cold call
scams.signals_en: Unsolicited caller pitches exclusive high-return opportunities in shares, cryptocurrency, foreign exchange, or commodities, using polished financial jargon and time-limited bonuses to pressure an immediate transfer.
scams.legit_en: FCA-authorised investment and financial services firms in the United Kingdom do not cold-call members of the public with urgent guaranteed-return offers, and genuine firms can always be checked independently on the FCA Firm Checker.
bait_tactics: Ask the caller to spell the firm's registered legal name slowly so you can look it up on the FCA Firm Checker first
Say your tablet battery is nearly flat and you cannot find the charging lead anywhere in the study
